title: wb pickup renders peers as headers only, so no node sees another board's watch-outs, decisions or standing directives at boot
body:
`intent wb pickup` renders the acting node's own items in full and every peer as one header line (role, status, heartbeat, focus), so at boot no node sees another board's watch-outs, decisions or standing directives. The standing content is reachable -- `intent wb show <peer>` renders it in full -- and on no boot path.

Measured on Intent 2026-09-16 at `d24487079`: `intent wb pickup --node vc` rendered vc's nine items in full and four peers as one line each; `intent wb show hv` rendered hv's 27 live items. Found by intent/dc the same morning: dc followed the protocol exactly, picked up, and opened a diagnosis of `a_daemon_outlives_nobody.rs` without seeing hv's watchout 11, which had ruled that flake known and shipping as-is on 2026-09-11. The diagnosis was stood down, and the morning was the cost.

**Why nobody reported it in weeks of daily use across five nodes (dc's sharpening):** pickup renders the watch-out surface COMPLETELY for self and not at all for peers, so the read does not look empty -- it looks complete. A node reading its own watch-outs in full has every reason to believe it has seen the watch-out surface.

**Why it is urgent now:** 0375 gave hv's board a `## Standing directives` section, whose purpose is durable instructions every node honours, and there is no path by which a booting node sees one. The whiteboard skill names this failure itself: a write surface with no named reader is a queue, not a channel, and nothing observable distinguishes the two. Devbin's roster separately tells every peer to read Standing directives at pickup (see the render-order issue filed with this one, devbin letter C).

Ruled by hv on 2026-09-16 to be fixed in this release (hv decision 18).

Fix: `wb pickup` returns the standing content every node is obliged to honour -- at least the hv node's directives, decisions and watch-outs -- in full, and says what it is not showing for the other peers and which verb shows it.

**CLOSED 2026-09-16, landed on vc's word.** `intent wb pickup` now returns `hv`'s live directives, watch-outs and decisions in full, in board section order, and every peer's header carries a `not shown:` line counting its live items by kind and naming `intent wb show <peer>`. Archived items are neither shown nor counted. The rule lives in intentsvcs: `facade::STANDING_KINDS` names the kinds, `views::BOARD_SECTIONS` is the one section order the board view and the pickup share, and `Pickup.standing` is absent when the acting node is `hv` (its own board already carries them) or there is no `hv` board, so an empty list only ever means `hv` holds none. The JSON and MCP answers are additive: each peer keeps its header fields and gains `unshown`. Built by dc, reviewed and finished by cc on vc's routing. Guarded by `tests/wb_pickup_states_the_session.rs`. The dispatch row and the in-whiteboard skill stop saying peers come back as headers only; the skill reaches installed projects through `intent claude skills sync`, a quiet-window step.
